# Havn Career Hub

> Havn is a job board for Norway, in English and Norwegian. Every job shows the pay (stated by the employer or a clearly marked estimate). Free for job seekers.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://havncareerhub.com/): find jobs in Norway and see the pay first
- [All jobs](https://havncareerhub.com/jobs/): current job listings
- [Sitemap](https://havncareerhub.com/sitemap.xml)

## Facts
- Market: Norway only
- Languages: English and Norwegian
- Posts are human-reviewed; no hidden salaries
